name: Graft
description: Mirror task worktree into its root repo checkout via graft

task_sidebar.status: PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" graft list | awk -v w=${{ worktree.path }} -F '  <-  ' '{sub(/  \(pid [0-9]+\)$/, "", $2); if ($2 == w) print $1}' | grep -q .
task_sidebar.stop: r=$(PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" graft list | awk -v w=${{ worktree.path }} -F '  <-  ' '{sub(/  \(pid [0-9]+\)$/, "", $2); if ($2 == w) print $1}'); [ -n "$r" ] && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" graft stop "$r"
